tests.name: B exam
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "answer must start with the correct letter");
tests.hint: B. The index g[i][length-1-i] walks the anti-diagonal: g[0][1] + g[1][0] = 2 + 4 = 6. A is the mirror misapplication (the main diagonal is g[i][i]); D sums everything.
